title: &aThe Arcane Path
subtitle: Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks: books, ink, scrolls, orbs, schools and addons.

quests.title: The Arcane Path
desc: Spells come two ways: &escrolls&r (cast once, then gone) and &espellbooks&r (keep spells for good, cast with mana). You've tried both in Act I; this chapter goes deeper.
&eArcane Essence&r is the mage's basic reagent. Craft &eIron's Guidebook&r (a book plus one Arcane Essence): the mod's own guide, with a page for every system here.

quests.title: Casting Like a Mage
desc: Hold the &eSpell Wheel&r key to choose a spell from your book, then press &eCast Selected Spell&r. Quick-cast slots let you bind favourites to their own keys. Search 'Iron' in Controls to see and change them.
Each spell costs mana and has a cooldown. Some are instant, some you hold to channel. Mana refills over time; rings and armour raise it.

quests.title: The Schools of Magic
desc: Every spell belongs to a school: &cFire&r, &bIce&r, &eLightning&r, &6Holy&r, &5Ender&r, &4Blood&r, &fEvocation&r, &aNature&r, &3Eldritch&r. The addons add Abyssal and others.

Each light leans on its own: Red fire and blood, Blue ice, Yellow lightning, Green evocation and holy, Orange earthy nature, Violet ender and eldritch, Indigo summons. School armour and orbs make your school stronger.

quests.title: The Alchemist Cauldron
desc: The &eAlchemist Cauldron&r brews elixirs (healing, evasion, invisibility, oakskin) and upgrades ink. Light a fire under it and fill it with water or ink.
It needs Cinder Essence, which the Ancient Knights of the old citadels drop.

quests.title: The Ink Ladder
desc: Ink sets how rare a scroll you can write. Pour a bucket's worth (four bottles) of ink into the cauldron and add a metal to brew the next rarity:
&fCommon&r + copper = &aUncommon&r, + iron = &9Rare&r, + gold = &5Epic&r, + amethyst = &6Legendary&r. Brew some &9Rare Ink&r.

quests.title: The Scroll Forge
desc: Build a &eScroll Forge&r (polished deepslate and crying obsidian). Put in ink, paper and a &eschool focus&r (a blaze rod for fire, a frozen bone for ice...), then pick a spell to write.
Rarer ink unlocks rarer spells. This is how you get the exact spell you want instead of hoping for loot.

quests.title: The Arcane Anvil
desc: The &eArcane Anvil&r is the mage's workbench. Combine two scrolls of the same spell and level into one of the next level. &eImbue&r a spell into a weapon so it casts on use.
It also applies &eupgrade orbs&r to armour and trinkets. Craft one (amethyst blocks, a diamond, an anvil, polished deepslate).

quests.title: Runes and Orbs
desc: Surround a &eBlank Runestone&r with eight focus items of one school to make that school's &erune&r. Eight runes around an &eEmpty Upgrade Orb&r make a school orb.
The empty orb takes arcane ingots, cinder essence and mithril. Make one.

quests.title: More Mana
desc: A &eMana Upgrade Orb&r (arcane runes) raises your maximum mana; a school orb raises that school's spell power. Apply them at the Arcane Anvil.
Each piece of gear takes a limited number of upgrades. Pick the orbs that match your class.

quests.title: A Bigger Book
desc: Better spellbooks hold more spells and add mana. The ladder goes Flimsy Journal, &eIronbound Tome&r, Apprentice's Spell Book, Enchanted Spell Book, Ancient Codex.
Unique books (Necronomicon, Druidic Tome, Frostbranded Book...) come from bosses and dungeons and boost one school. Get an Ironbound Tome.

quests.title: Robes of Your School
desc: School armour boosts one school's power and your mana: &cPyromancer&r, &bCryomancer&r, &eElectromancer&r, &6Priest&r, &5Shadow-Walker&r, &4Cultist&r, &aPlagued&r, &fArchevoker&r, and the all-round Wizard robes.
Most need &eArcane Cloth&r. Craft or loot a set for your school.

quests.title: Mithril Weave
desc: Mithril from deep in the deepslate turns into scrap, ingots, then &eMithril Weave&r, which goes into the strongest robes (Netherite Battlemage).
See the Mining chapter for where to find it.

quests.title: The Enchanted Spell Book
desc: The &eEnchanted Spell Book&r (diamond) holds a proper arsenal: attack, defence, movement and healing all in one book.
Each book has a rarity limit: a scroll that's too rare won't go into a cheap book. Inscribe your best scrolls at the Inscription Table.

quests.title: The Ancient Codex
desc: The &eAncient Codex&r is the best crafted spellbook: the most slots and the most mana.
A full Codex of Legendary spells is the mark of an archmage. The corruption fears it.

quests.title: Into the Catacombs
desc: A &eWayward Compass&r points to the &eCatacombs&r, the crypt where the Dead King sleeps. Iron's other structures (pyromancer towers, the evoker fort, the ice spider den, the citadel) hide mages, knights and rare books.
Enter the Catacombs. The Dead King himself is in the Bosses chapter.

quests.title: A Familiar of Your Own
quests.subtitle: Alshanex's Familiars
desc: Little magical &efamiliars&r live all over the world: archmages, clerics, druids, hunters, necromancers, scorchers and more. Right-click one with &eArcane Essence&r to tame it (each try has a 40% chance).
Craft the &eFamiliar Compendium&r (a book and a rabbit's foot) to learn where each lives. Wildheart players: familiars are part of your path.

quests.title: The Sterling Tome
quests.subtitle: Galosphere: Spellbooks
desc: &eGalosphere: Spellbooks&r turns Galosphere's metals and crystals into magic gear: the &eSterling Tome&r (palladium), Sterling robes and the Allurite Pendant.
Craft a Sterling Tome. Palladium is in the Mining chapter.

quests.title: Spells of the Cataclysm
quests.subtitle: Cataclysm: Spellbooks
desc: &eCataclysm: Spellbooks&r adds the &3Abyssal&r school and gear forged from Cataclysm bosses: Ignis mage robes, Abyssal Warlock robes, Excelsius armour, the Book o' R'lyeh.
Bless a Ruined Book on a Cataclysm amethyst altar to make the Book o' R'lyeh. Abyssal runes take abyssal focus items. Use JEI to plan your set.

quests.title: Discerning the Eldritch
desc: Eldritch cults gather in hidden places: the &eCultist Base&r, blood cultist huts and the Electromancer Tower. Their apostles and acolytes cast forbidden spells.
Find a Cultist Base. Read their &eGuardian's Guidebook&r if you find one: it is this addon's guide.

quests.title: The Ascended One
desc: At the heart of the cult waits the &5Ascended One&r, one of the deadliest mages in the world. Its fall opens the way to the eldritch arts (Eldritch Soulshards, the Apocrypha, demonic weapons).
An extreme fight. Bring your best book, your best robes and your whole party.
